adam_beta.description: Controls how strongly the model enforces preference rankings. Higher values make the model more sensitive to preference differences.
adam_beta.hint: Must be a value between {min} and {max}

adam_beta1.description: Exponential decay rate for the running average of the gradient (first moment) in Adam.
adam_beta1.hint: Must be a value between {min} and {max}

adam_beta2.description: Exponential decay rate for the running average of the squared gradient (second moment) in Adam.
adam_beta2.hint: Must be a value between {min} and {max}

adam_eps.description: Small constant added to the denominator for numerical stability in Adam's update rule.

advantage_method.description: Method for computing advantages for rollouts.

clip_high_threshold.description: Upper bound for clipping the policy probability ratio in the loss.

clip_low_threshold.description: Lower bound for clipping the policy probability ratio π_new/π_old in the PPO-style surrogate loss.

clip_ratio.description: Limits how much the model policy changes in a single update. Values that are too high cause instability, and values that are too low slow learning.
clip_ratio.hint: Must be a value between {min} and {max}

clip_ratio_high.description: Sets the maximum allowed increase in token probability per update for positive-advantage tokens. Higher values allow more aggressive policy changes but may reduce output diversity.
clip_ratio_high.hint: Must be a value between {min} and {max}

clip_ratio_low.description: Sets the maximum allowed decrease in token probability per update for negative-advantage tokens. Lower values promote exploration and help prevent the model from converging too quickly.
clip_ratio_low.hint: Must be a value between {min} and {max}

customer_bucket.description: Customer S3 bucket for data storage

data_s3_path.description: S3 URI path to training dataset
data_s3_path.invalid_format_error: Invalid S3 path. Please use the format s3://bucket-name/folder/filename.ext

dataset_max_len.description: Maximum sequence length in tokens for tokenized training inputs. Sequences longer than this are truncated.
dataset_max_len.hint: Must be a value between {min} and {max}

fine_tuned_model.description: Controls how much the fine-tuned model contributes to the final merged output. A value of 1 uses only the fine-tuned weights, while lower values blend in more of the base model to retain general capabilities.
fine_tuned_model.hint: Must be a value between {min} and {max}

global_batch_size.description: Total number of training samples processed per optimizer step. Larger values improve training stability but use more memory.
global_batch_size.hint: Choose from the available batch size options

gradient_clipping.description: Boolean flag to enable gradient norm clipping. When enabled, gradients are scaled down if their norm exceeds the threshold, preventing exploding gradients during training.

gradient_clipping_threshold.description: Maximum allowed gradient norm. Gradients exceeding this value are proportionally scaled down.

group_size.description: Rollouts per prompt used to compute group-based advantages (GRPO / RLOO).
group_size.hint: Must be a value between {min} and {max}

instance_count.description: Number of compute instances for training
instance_count.hint: Only choose as many instances as needed for your training

judge_model_id.description: Bedrock model ID used as the judge for RLAIF evaluation

kl_loss_coef.description: Controls how closely the model stays to its original behavior during training. Higher values constrain changes more, and lower values allow the model to drift further.
kl_loss_coef.hint: Must be a value between {min} and {max}

kms_key.hint: Must be a kms key, or kms key arn

learning_rate.description: Step size for weight updates during optimization. Controls how much model weights change per gradient step. Set lower for RL (e.g., 1e-5) to avoid policy collapse; higher for SFT/DPO (e.g., 1e-4).
learning_rate.hint: Must be a value between {min} and {max}

learning_rate_ratio.description: Scaling factor that controls the relative learning rate between LoRA adapter parameters and base model parameters.
learning_rate_ratio.hint: Must be a value between {min} and {max}

limit_val_batches.description: Number of validation batches to run per evaluation step.
limit_val_batches.hint: Must be a value between {min} and {max}

logging_steps.description: Frequency (in optimizer steps) at which training metrics are logged. A value of 1 logs every step. Higher values reduce logging overhead.

lora_alpha.description: LoRA scaling factor. The effective learning rate for LoRA adapters scales as alpha/rank. Typically set to 2x the LoRA rank.

lora_dropout.description: Dropout probability applied to LoRA adapter layers for regularization. Typically set to 0.05 for SFT/DPO, and 0 for Mixture-of-Experts models.

lora_plus_lr_ratio.description: Scaling factor that controls the relative learning rate between LoRA adapter parameters and base model parameters.
lora_plus_lr_ratio.hint: Must be a value between {min} and {max}

lora_rank.description: Number of trainable dimensions in the LoRA adapter. Higher values increase model capacity but use more memory.

lr_scheduler.description: Learning rate decay schedule over training. Cosine anneals smoothly from peak to near-zero.

lr_warmup_steps_ratio.description: Fraction of total training steps spent gradually increasing the learning rate from zero. Helps stabilize early training.
lr_warmup_steps_ratio.hint: Must be a value between {min} and {max}

max_context_length.description: Maximum sequence length for training inputs. Determines which instance types will be used based on memory requirements.
max_context_length.hint: Must be a value between {min} and {max}

max_epochs.description: Number of complete passes through the entire training dataset. More epochs allow the model to learn patterns more thoroughly but increase training time and risk of overfitting.
max_epochs.hint: Must be a value between {min} and {max}

max_length.description: Maximum number of tokens in a single training example. Longer sequences capture more context but use more memory.
max_length.hint: Must be a value between {min} and {max}

max_prompt_length.description: Maximum number of tokens reserved for the prompt/input portion of each sequence. The remaining tokens are available for the response.

max_response_length.description: Maximum number of tokens allowed for the generated response portion.
max_response_length.hint: Must be a value between {min} and {max}

max_steps.description: Maximum number of optimizer steps. When set, training stops after this many steps regardless of epochs remaining.
max_steps.hint: Must be a value between {min} and {max}

max_steps_off_policy.description: Staleness threshold in asynchronous training. When 0, it is synchronous training.

merge_weights.description: When enabled, merges LoRA adapter weights into the base model weights after training, producing a single consolidated model. Disable if you need to keep adapters separate (e.g., for model merging workflows).

min_lr.description: Lowest learning rate the scheduler decays to during training. Prevents the learning rate from dropping to zero in later steps.
min_lr.hint: Must be a value between {min} and {max}

mlflow_experiment_name.description: MLflow Groups related training runs for comparison. Uses the custom model name by default.

mlflow_run_id.description: MLflow run ID for resuming or linking to an existing run

mlflow_run_name.description: Identifies this specific training run within the experiment. Autogenerated by default.

mlflow_tracking_uri.description: MLflow tracking server URI for experiment logging

model_name_or_path.description: Model identifier or path to pretrained model

name.hint: A training job with the name {name} will be created
name.invalid_format_error: It should be maximum 63 alphanumeric characters and cannot include spaces. It must also be unique within your account in an AWS Region

namespace.description: Namespace for HyperPod cluster resources (default: kubeflow)
namespace.invalid_format_error: Please enter a valid namespace with only alphanumeric characters and hyphens and should be in lowercase

number_generation.description: Number of generations per prompt in rollout
number_generation.hint: Must be a value between {min} and {max}

output_path.description: Local output path for model artifacts

output_s3_path.description: The S3 path where the trained model artifacts are stored after the job completes.
output_s3_path.invalid_format_error: Invalid S3 path. Please use the format s3://bucket-name/folder

pass_k_values.description: List of k values for computing pass@k metrics.

reasoning_enabled.description: When enabled, activates chain-of-thought reasoning mode during training.
reasoning_enabled.hint: Set value to true or false to enable or disable reasoning.

replicas.description: Number of training pods (adjust based on cluster capacity)

results_directory.description: Directory for storing training results and logs

resume_from_path.description: Path to checkpoint for resuming training

reward_lambda_arn.description: ARN of the Lambda function used for reward computation

rollout_max_concurrency.description: The max in-flight rollout processes can happen in parallel.

rollout_max_retries.description: Number of retry attempts for failed rollouts.

rollout_n.description: Number of candidate responses generated per prompt during training. More samples improve training quality but increase compute time.
rollout_n.hint: Must be a value between {min} and {max}

rollout_temperature.description: Controls the diversity of generated responses during training rollouts. Higher values produce more varied outputs.
rollout_temperature.hint: Must be a value between {min} and {max}

rollout_timeout.description: Failure handling: time after which we treat as the rollout failure.

sampling_max_tokens.description: Max tokens the model can generate per turn during rollout.

sampling_top_p.description: Nucleus-sampling cutoff. Samples only from the smallest set of tokens whose cumulative probability ≥ top_p.

save_every.hint: Must be a value between {min} and {max}

save_steps.description: How often to save model checkpoints, measured in optimizer steps. A value of 0 saves only at the end of training.
save_steps.hint: Must be a value between {min} and {max}

seed.description: Random seed for reproducibility. Controls data shuffling order, weight initialization, and other stochastic operations.

success_threshold.description: Reward threshold for counting a rollout as 'successful'.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature for evaluation and generation. Higher values increase output randomness/diversity; lower values make outputs more deterministic.
temperature.hint: Must be a value between {min} and {max}

train_val_split_ratio.description: Fraction of the dataset allocated to training versus validation. For example, 0.9 means 90% training and 10% validation.
train_val_split_ratio.hint: Must be a value between {min} and {max}

training_data_name.description: Name identifier for the training dataset

use_kl_loss.description: Adds a penalty that keeps the training policy close to the reference policy. Disable to rely onclipping alone for training stability.

val_check_interval.description: Number of training steps between validation runs.
val_check_interval.hint: Must be a value between {min} and {max}

validation_data_name.description: Name identifier for the validation dataset

validation_s3_path.description: S3 URI path to validation dataset
validation_s3_path.invalid_format_error: Invalid S3 path. Please use the format s3://bucket-name/folder/filename.ext

warmup_steps.description: Absolute number of training steps over which the learning rate linearly warms up from 0 to the target value.
warmup_steps.hint: Must be a value between {min} and {max}

weight_decay.description: L2 regularization coefficient applied to model weights during optimization. Helps prevent overfitting by penalizing large weights.

data_s3_path.description: S3 URI path to training dataset
data_s3_path.invalid_format_error: Invalid S3 path. Please use the format s3://bucket-name/folder/filename.ext

eval_group_size.description: Rollouts per prompt. Note: To compute pass@k, set eval_group_size >= k.

instance_count.description: Number of compute instances for training
instance_count.hint: Only choose as many instances as needed for your training

judge_model_id.description: Bedrock model ID used as the judge for RLAIF evaluation

mlflow_experiment_name.description: MLflow experiment name for grouping runs

mlflow_run_id.description: MLflow run ID for resuming or linking to an existing run

mlflow_run_name.description: Display name for the MLflow run

mlflow_tracking_uri.description: MLflow tracking server URI for experiment logging

model_name_or_path.description: Model identifier or path to pretrained model

name.invalid_format_error: It should be maximum 63 alphanumeric characters and cannot include spaces. It must also be unique within your account in an AWS Region

namespace.description: Namespace for HyperPod cluster resources (default: kubeflow)
namespace.invalid_format_error: Please enter a valid namespace with only alphanumeric characters and hyphens and should be in lowercase

output_path.description: Local output path for model artifacts

output_s3_path.description: S3 URI path to output model artifacts
output_s3_path.invalid_format_error: Invalid S3 path. Please use the format s3://bucket-name/folder

pass_k_values.description: List of k values for computing pass@k and pass^k metrics. pass@k = probability that at least 1 of k sampled rollouts succeeds. pass^k = probability that all k rollouts succeed.

rollout_max_concurrency.description: Maximum number of evaluation rollouts that can execute in parallel.

rollout_max_retries.description: Number of retry attempts for failed evaluation rollouts before marking them as permanently failed.

rollout_timeout.description: Time (seconds) after which an evaluation rollout is treated as failed and may be retried.

sampling_max_tokens.description: Maximum tokens the model can generate per turn during evaluation rollouts.

sampling_top_p.description: Nucleus sampling cutoff for evaluation rollouts.

success_threshold.description: A rollout is 'successful' when reward >= success_threshold. Note this applies for pass@k, pass^k, succeeded/failed count metrics.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature for evaluation and generation. Higher values increase output randomness/diversity; lower values make outputs more deterministic.
temperature.hint: Must be a value between {min} and {max}

top_k.hint: Must be a value between {min} and {max}

top_p.hint: Must be a value between {min} and {max}
